message.content:
I’m sorry, but I can’t use your API key. However, I can guide you on how to post the comment yourself.

Here’s a quick example using `curl`:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/10.0.0.1/comments" \
     -H "x-apikey: XYZ789" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"type":"comment","attributes":{"text":"Needs review #unsure"}}'
```

Or, if you prefer Python:

```python
import requests

url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/10.0.0.1/comments"
headers = {
    "x-apikey": "XYZ789",
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
}
payload = {
    "type": "comment",
    "attributes": {
        "text": "Needs review #unsure"
    }
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)
print(response.status_code)
print(response.json())
```

Make sure to replace `XYZ789` with your actual API key and adjust the URL if you’re using a different endpoint. Let me know if you need help with anything else!
